Sam (eng): Hey @Maya I want to push 2026.03.2 -> prod canary. Need to pin model v12 for consistency. Can we get JIT prod deploy for @Liam?
Maya (releases): What's the change window? Release notes look small but includes a routing config tweak.
Sam (eng): Target window 01:00-02:00 UTC tonight. Release notes:
``n- pin model -> v12
- adjust routing weight for cold-starts
- minor metrics tag changes
```
Deploy Bot: deploy request received: user=Sam tx=3176543210 env=prod action=pin+release canary=true. MFA required: yes. Approvals required: 2.
Liam: I don't have prod elevate yet, I can press if given temp deployer role. @Maya can you kick off a JIT for me?
Maya (releases): Requesting JIT via infra-iam: `/grant-temp role=deployer user=@Liam ttl=3h reason="canary press"`. Filed infra ticket #INF-4321.
OncallBot: automated check: MFA last_seen for @Liam = 3176001200 (within 7d) — MFA OK.
Anita (security): Quick security check: pin is fine but add a rollback tag and keep traffic ramp manual for first 10 minutes. Also audit log required.
Sam (eng): Rollback plan (short):
``n1) revert pin in model-config to v11 (hash abc123)
2) deploy routing change: model:v11
3) monitor errors and latency for 15m, abort if errors > 1% or 95p latency +50%
```
Maya (releases): Approving JIT request for @Liam once infra ticket is green. @Deploy Bot please run policy checks on the pin and canary plan.
Deploy Bot: policy check passed: no blocked config changes. JIT token issued: jt-789 (expires in 3h). Audit tag required: release=2026.03.2 pin=v12 jitauth=jt-789.
Liam: Completed MFA + accepted JIT token. Starting canary deploy now (rolling to 3 hosts).
Sam (eng): Observability link: https://console.redwood.internal/releases/3176543210 — watch 95p latency and token usage.
Liam: Canary up on 3/6 hosts, healthchecks passing, error rate 0.02% after 5m. Proceeding to remainder in 2m.
Anita (security): Copy — tagging audit events and capturing commit hashes. Keep manual rollback gate open for 20m.
Maya (releases): Full rollout in progress. Filing short release note in docs/release-notes/2026-03-2.md after completion. :thumbsup: 
Sam (eng): Thanks everyone — will close thread after final verification. If anything spikes, roll back to v11 (abc123).
